governing_law.name: Law No. 182 of 2018 — Regulating Contracts Concluded by Public Entities
objectives: Protect against monopolistic and corrupt practices

two_envelope_system.purpose: Ensure qualitative evaluation is not initially biased by price

contents: All required corporate and legal documentation
technical_envelope.rejection_rule: If technical proposal fails minimum scoring threshold OR lacks mandatory administrative documents → bid rejected ENTIRELY, financial envelope never opened

financial_envelope.opened: SECOND — only for bidders who pass technical evaluation

foreign_entities: Correct legal entity established (LLC or Foreign Company Branch)
Legalisation and apostille of parent company documents
Certified Arabic translations of all foreign documents

final_performance.validity: Remains valid until project completion or lapse of warranty period

prohibitions: Single bidder submitting more than one bid for same tender
Bidding independently AND in partnership through shared ownership/management
Bid rigging — conspiring to fix prices, allocate market shares, or predetermine winner
Submitting identical technical terms across related entities
penalties: Referral to ECA for prosecution under Egyptian Competition Law

domestic_preference.governing_law: Law No. 5 of 2015 — Preference for Egyptian Products in Government Contracts
domestic_preference.local_component_threshold: Egyptian industrial component must exceed 40% of total product cost
domestic_preference.calculation: Deduct value of imported components from total cost
domestic_preference.enforcement: If foreign bidder has lowest price, contract STILL awarded to Egyptian contractor if their bid ≤ foreign bid + 15%
domestic_preference.strategic_implication: Foreign multinationals must form local JVs or source raw materials domestically to remain competitive

gcc_comparison.qatar: 10% preference for national products, 5% for GCC-origin
gcc_comparison.note: Factor geographic handicaps into Green Team pricing models

vat.law: VAT Law No. 67 of 2016 and subsequent amendments
vat.construction_change: Shifted from 5% schedule tax to 14% standard VAT
vat.input_deductibility: Full deductibility of input VAT on goods, machinery, and subcontracted services for contractors
vat.pricing_impact: Reduces net costs but requires meticulous invoicing — drastically alters pricing strategy

requirements: Full harmonization and mandatory compliance by 2026–2027
e_invoicing.consequence: Bidders failing to demonstrate ETA digital integration risk disqualification

benefits: Full exemption from capital gains tax on fixed asset sales

grace_periods.cap: Late penalties capped at 100% of original tax due

bilingual_requirements.arabic_mandatory: Senior executives and public sector evaluation committees in Egypt
bilingual_requirements.english_default: International consortiums operating within MENA borders
bilingual_requirements.critical_rule: Direct machine translation is universally inadequate and detrimental to credibility
bilingual_requirements.requirement: Generate native Arabic content respecting formal regional business dialects
bilingual_requirements.digital_presence: Corporate websites must reflect bilingual standard — procurement directors conduct independent online audits
